evidence.fact: The standalone main preserves the three legacy tasks initialization/dynamic/closure and calls swap(iCaller,iTask,tstart_in,tend_in) without the optional worker context.
canonical_trial is defined as present(worker); when worker is absent the code follows the legacy compatibility context.

F-CI06 explicitly requires standalone_calls_unchanged, admits only CONTROLLED_SOURCE_PORT_SEAM, does not admit FULL_PHYSICAL_TRANSACTION_ADAPTER, and records full B1.10 end-to-end numerical reference qualification as pending.
The permanent capability bank covers transaction/mass, restart, serialized MultiSWAP, full Richards, solver seam and ET/process surfaces, but contains no Hupsel or full file-driven standalone oracle.
Broad public API / wholesale legacy IO modernization is explicitly future scope, not part of the Status-A denominator.

adversarial_check.invalid_shortcut: Run the official Hupsel case through src/legacy/b1_10_port/swap_main.f90 and call the result SWAP5.
adversarial_check.why_invalid: The standalone call omits worker and therefore does not prove the canonical transactional production path. Exact agreement could merely demonstrate preserved legacy compatibility, producing a false-positive SWAP5 equivalence claim.

next_permitted_action: If full Hupsel end-to-end comparison becomes an explicit acceptance surface, start a separately bounded qualification/application-composition workunit. First prove an existing canonical transactional composition without changing physics or implementing wholesale IO/API, then freeze variable/time mapping and tolerances before observing SWAP5 differences.
